## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Verification

List the checks, datasets, sensor configuration, random seed, and platform used.

## Evidence

Include relevant metrics or before/after images. Distinguish simulation, fitting, and physical validation.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no generated data, checkpoints, local preferences, or temporary files.
- [ ] Public behavior and configuration changes are documented.
- [ ] Numerical claims include the evaluation protocol and can be reproduced.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, or machine-specific paths are included.
